headline: US bitcoin funds are on track for their worst month on record, with about $5.39 billion out in November, as bitcoin trades near $60,000 on the US Thanksgiving holiday ahead of Friday's roughly $7 billion options expiry.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap on Thu 26 Nov between about 11:50 and 12:30 UTC (18:50-19:30 Bangkok). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Extreme fear: 13 on Alternative.me's Crypto Fear and Greed Index and 9 on CoinMarketCap's index, both read about 11:50 UTC.

stories.title: US bitcoin funds head for their worst month on record after a seventh straight day of outflows
stories.summary: Money has left US spot bitcoin funds for seven days in a row, and November's withdrawals are already bigger than any previous month.
points: US spot bitcoin funds lost a net $453.1 million on Wed 25 Nov, the seventh straight outflow day, per The Block.
BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $329.7 million of Wednesday's outflow, per The Block.
November outflows now total about $5.39 billion, more than any previous month, per The Block.
US spot ether funds lost $68.5 million on Wednesday, their ninth straight outflow day, per The Block.

sources.label: The Block: spot bitcoin ETFs head for worst month

stories.title: Bitcoin trades near $60,000 as the US marks Thanksgiving, with a big options expiry on Friday
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $57,300 on Wednesday, then recovered toward $60,000. US stock markets are closed for Thanksgiving, and about $7 billion of bitcoin options expire on Friday.
points: Bitcoin hit a low of about $57,300 on Wednesday, per The Block.
Core PCE inflation came in at 3.3% a year, above the 3.2% forecast, and markets expect a December Fed rate hike, per CoinDesk.
The US Trade Representative proposed tariffs on 14 economies, including 20% extra on China and 15% on the EU and Japan; comments are due 5 Jan 2027, per Saxo.
About $692 million of leveraged bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours, per CoinGlass data reported by crypto.news.
About $7 billion of bitcoin options and $0.6 billion of ether options expire on Deribit on Friday 27 Nov, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: A bill to hold US government bitcoin for 20 years reaches the full House, but time is short
stories.summary: A bill to write a US Strategic Bitcoin Reserve into law can now get a House vote, but it also needs the Senate and a signature before this Congress ends on 3 January.
points: H.R. 8957, the American Reserve Modernization Act, was sent to the full House on 24 Nov, per The Block.
The bill would bar any sale of reserve bitcoin for at least 20 years, per The Block.
Addresses linked to the US government hold about 306,795 BTC, per Arkham data reported by CoinDesk.
Polymarket's odds of a US bitcoin reserve by the end of 2026 were 4%, down from 34% in May, per The Block.

briefs.title: Crypto market maker Auros reportedly winding down
briefs.summary: The Hong Kong trading firm is shutting down, according to two people familiar with the matter cited by CoinDesk; the reason and timetable are unclear.

briefs.title: Zcash developers urge users to leave an old privacy pool
briefs.summary: About 400,000 ZEC still sits in Zcash's 2018 Sapling pool; developers propose allowing withdrawals only, as a precaution, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: 1Password breach raises phishing risk
briefs.summary: An attacker exposed 1Password customer names and emails; the company says vaults and passwords were not exposed. Binance founder CZ urged users to change stored passwords anyway, per FinanceFeeds.

briefs.title: 77 German cooperative banks file to offer crypto trading
briefs.summary: Up from 56 in October, they would use DZ BANK's meinKrypto platform under the EU's MiCA rules, per TokenPost.

briefs.title: Switzerland picks 57 partners for crypto tax-data sharing from 2028
briefs.summary: The list, under the OECD framework, covers all EU states and the UK, per The Block.

briefs.title: Senate Democrats ask the SEC to drop its planned crypto exemptions
briefs.summary: Senators led by Warren and Van Hollen want the SEC's proposed "Regulation Crypto" and an "innovation exemption" withdrawn, per The Block.

briefs.title: Fidelity files for a spot Chainlink fund
briefs.summary: Fidelity filed to list a spot Chainlink (LINK) fund on Nasdaq under the ticker FLNK; it will not stake its LINK, per The Block.

briefs.title: A spot bitcoin ETF starts trading in Switzerland
briefs.summary: BIT's BBIT has begun trading on the SIX exchange holding 350 BTC, with a 0.19% yearly fee, per The Block.

calendar.note: No US stock trading today. Stocks close early on Friday 27 Nov at 1:00pm ET (01:00 Sat Bangkok), per NYSE owner ICE; US bond markets close early at 2:00pm ET, per SIFMA.

calendar.event: Token unlocks: HUMA, PROS, GRASS, FF, CARDS, GRVT, KMNO, GUN, EIGEN, SUI, M, BTW, ENA, 2Z, STO, MMT, LA
calendar.note: HUMA on Thursday 26; PROS and GRASS on Saturday 28; FF and CARDS on Sunday 29; GRVT, KMNO and GUN on Monday 30; EIGEN and SUI on Tuesday 1 Dec; M, BTW, ENA and 2Z on Wednesday 2 Dec; STO on Thursday 3 Dec; MMT and LA on Friday 4 Dec. Trackers disagree on the date for GRVT and M (one tracker now says 12 Dec for M). See the unlock table on this page for sizes and confidence. (Dates from this desk's unlock data.)

Expires at 08:00 UTC. About $7 billion of bitcoin options and $0.6 billion of ether options expire on Deribit, put/call ratio 0.89, per CoinDesk. Bitcoinist (PiSpace data) gives $6.92 billion with "max pain" at $71,000; OKX's 24 Nov post put max pain at $72,000.

calendar.event: Fed officials stop public comments before the December meeting
calendar.note: The blackout runs to Thu 10 Dec, under the Fed's blackout rules.
At the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, per Daily Tribune.
October was 55.3, per Newsquawk. Release time per MNI.

calendar.event: MSCI removes Strategy (MSTR) from its indexes
calendar.note: Takes effect at the end of November. MSCI-linked funds hold about 13 million MSTR shares, about 3.1% of the total, by Strategy's own estimate reported by Cointelegraph.

calendar.event: ISM manufacturing PMI (Nov), job openings (JOLTS, Oct); House hearing on bank regulators
calendar.note: ISM: consensus 55 per Nowflation; October was 55.5. JOLTS: consensus 7.3 million per Nowflation, September 7.52 million. The House Financial Services Committee holds an "Oversight of Prudential Regulators" hearing at 10:00am ET. CrowdStrike reports earnings after the close; Marvell holds its earnings call at 4:30pm ET.
October was +86,000, per InvestingLive. No published consensus found. Salesforce reports earnings after the close.
October was 54.5, per InvestingLive. Weekly jobless claims come out the same day at 8:30am ET; last week's figure was 189,000, per the Labor Department.

Forecasts differ: +82,000 jobs and 4.2% unemployment per Nowflation; U.S. Bank cites a +101,000 consensus and forecasts +98,000 itself. October payrolls rose 165,000 with unemployment at 4.1%, per the BLS.
Markets expect a rate hike, not a cut. CME FedWatch put the chance of a quarter-point hike at 97.8% on 25 Nov, per MarketSpeaker. Press conference at 2:30pm ET.
